scope: Full fixed core medium-fi exterior, with explicitly approximate hidden detail.

quallaSearch.notes: Qualla media was checked first; useful local exteriors require attribution and are excluded. Three exact named-creator2005Ownwork/PD-self originals now show the western facade, Great Court/Hausmann tower and elevated roof/tower relationship. Assumed-author records, unrelated buildings and privately attributed exteriors are excluded.

originalReview.notes: Exact2293x1605native inspected: western pale facade/stone ornament, red gabled roof and paired corner crowns; top of nearer corner tower is cropped.

Exact1568x2240native inspected: court facade and Hausmann tower, large red/blue clock below viewing platform, single main window tier/small upper round lights, rounded lead roof, open lantern and needle.

Exact1676x2000native inspected: elevated Great Court/Hausmann view confirms roof/crown/lantern/needle hierarchy and courtyard sgraffito.2005worksites and unrestored small-court roofing are historical, not copied as present geometry.
